Returns m², pallets or slabs, cargo weight, what limits the load (weight or space), the 60/40 balan

tools.name: list_load_presets
tools.description: The packing presets the container planner knows: common porcelain tile, paver and slab formats and marble, travertine, granite and quartzite slabs, with their export packing and the format page that answers 'how much fits in a container' for each. Use an id as plan_container_load's preset.

tools.name: find_hs_code
tools.description: The HS 2022 six-digit customs code for natural stone, porcelain/ceramic tiles, engineered stone or ceramic sanitary ware, from the same decision table as the public HS code finder. tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the live Minux catalogue (porcelain tiles and slabs, natural stone) by name, category and format. Returns names, specifications and product page links in the buyer's language. No prices.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One catalogue product by its slug (from search_products): description, sizes, thickness, finish, origin, HS code as listed, minimum order as listed, the product page and a prefilled quote form for the buyer. No prices.

tools.name: build_quote_link
tools.description: A link to the Minux quote form, prefilled with a product and/or a container plan (a planner query such as preset=60x60-9&c=40hc&q=3000&qu=m2).
